answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybils with slashed stake: every agent locks a bond to earn mining or grading rights, and a node caught voting twice or faking identities loses that bond. A raider wanting N fake votes must lock N bonds, so the attack costs capital, not just compute. This crystal-clear price tag opens a canyon between honest rewards and fraud, since the kernel of the defense is that slashing burns the attacker's own locked value.
